insights.one_liner: Cover Genius is a fast-growing insurtech embedding insurance into apps like Booking.com and Uber; its Amsterdam entity is an IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: Builds embedded insurance for big digital companies such as Klarna, Revolut, Booking.com, eBay and Uber, active in over 60 countries.
Says it has protected 73M+ customers across 240M policies with USD 3.2 billion in gross written sales.

open.text: Cover Genius Europe B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one open job here, a sales internship in Amsterdam, does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Raised USD 100 million from Vista Credit Partners at a USD 1.9 billion valuation, aimed at global expansion.
Acquired Berlin insurtech Friendsurance to expand into European banking.

worth_knowing.text: The internship averaged 200 LinkedIn applicants, so expect stiff competition.
